keySentence: He changed and became a generous man.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Scrooge bought a big turkey. He sent it to Bob's family. He raised Bob's pay. He changed and became a generous man.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Scrooge bought the biggest turkey at the market for Bob's family. He gave Bob a huge raise and wished him a Merry Christmas. He went to his nephew's party and everyone welcomed him warmly. He changed and became a generous man who shared with everyone. He donated money to help the poor people of London. Scrooge discovered that giving made him happier than getting.
